request.prompt:
Deliverable: landscape flat fact-and-caveat infographic for a Chinese AI engineering article.
Primary request: put Jev's official headline numbers beside the caveats that must travel with them.
Composition: title at top. Left panel with header "官方核心数字" and four stacked cards: "70–500ms", "$0.042/MTok", "输出免费", "0% schema error（schema 内）". Right panel with header "引用时必须带口径" and four stacked cards: "官方自测", "4 个 workflow 平均", "schema 内不等于业务正确", "校准需自测". A full-width bottom banner reads "数字 + 口径，一起引用".
Style and medium: flat editorial data infographic, warm paper, coral and teal section headers, clean icons, thin ink lines, visually dense but highly readable, no 3D, no photorealism.
Text (exact): Allowed readable text only: "官方数字与引用口径", "官方核心数字", "70–500ms", "$0.042/MTok", "输出免费", "0% schema error（schema 内）", "引用时必须带口径", "官方自测", "4 个 workflow 平均", "schema 内不等于业务正确", "校准需自测", and "数字 + 口径，一起引用". Render each exactly once. No other readable text.
Avoid: extra numbers, invented percentages, duplicated labels, misspellings, watermark.
